P5: distribution/planner.py — switch build_plan to passable_route. uses R10. after P2.

Should planner change be included? Done-when says no delivery uses blocked road. R10 says call site would need to switch. Yes include.

rerouted_sites: sites in name order — sites_served returns sorted. Compare passable_route route vs best_route route (route id differs). Vehicle alone changing doesn't count — compare route ids.

notify_rerouted(sites, day): for each active household with site in sites and sms_ok, queue_sms(h.id, "DELIVERY_MOVED", {"site": h.site, "day": day}). Return messages sent. Note: "the household's site" — h.site. sites param is list of site ids presumably. Return list of SmsMessage.

Order: P1 access, P2 passable_route (after P1), P3 rerouted_sites (after P2), P4 notify_rerouted, P5 planner (after P2).
